title: Market Cap vs Revenue: Walmart Sells More, Worth Less
description:
Market cap is a company's share price times its number of shares, and it is not the same as revenue. Walmart's yearly sales ($713 billion) are more than double Microsoft's ($332 billion), yet on Nov 18, 2026 Microsoft was worth about $3.8 trillion and Walmart about $1.0 trillion. The difference is profit: Microsoft kept about 40% of its revenue as net income, Walmart about 3%.

Sources: Walmart Form 10-K for fiscal 2026 (year to Jan 31, 2026, filed Mar 13, 2026) and Form 10-Q (filed Aug 28, 2026, shares outstanding); Microsoft Form 10-K for fiscal 2026 (year to Jun 30, 2026, filed Jul 29, 2026) and Form 10-Q (filed Oct 28, 2026, shares outstanding); closing prices on Nov 18, 2026. Market caps change every trading day. Not financial advice and not a recommendation to buy or sell any stock.

es.title: Capitalización vs ingresos: Walmart vende más y vale menos
es.summary: La capitalización bursátil es el precio de la acción por el número de acciones, no las ventas. Walmart vende más del doble que Microsoft, pero Microsoft vale casi cuatro veces más.

pt.title: Valor de mercado x receita: Walmart vende mais e vale menos
pt.summary: Valor de mercado é o preço da ação vezes o número de ações, não as vendas. O Walmart vende mais que o dobro da Microsoft, mas a Microsoft vale quase quatro vezes mais.

hi.title: मार्केट कैप बनाम बिक्री: Walmart ज़्यादा बेचकर भी कम कीमती
hi.summary: मार्केट कैप = शेयर का दाम × शेयरों की संख्या, यह बिक्री नहीं है। Walmart की बिक्री Microsoft से दोगुनी से ज़्यादा है, फिर भी Microsoft लगभग चार गुना ज़्यादा मूल्यवान है।

id.title: Kapitalisasi Pasar vs Pendapatan: Walmart Jual Lebih Banyak
id.summary: Kapitalisasi pasar adalah harga saham dikali jumlah saham, bukan penjualan. Penjualan Walmart lebih dari dua kali Microsoft, tetapi Microsoft bernilai hampir empat kali lipat.

de.title: Börsenwert vs. Umsatz: Warum Walmart weniger wert ist
de.summary: Der Börsenwert ist Aktienkurs mal Anzahl der Aktien, nicht der Umsatz. Walmart setzt mehr als doppelt so viel um wie Microsoft, doch Microsoft ist fast viermal so viel wert.

fr.title: Capitalisation vs chiffre d'affaires : Walmart vend plus
fr.summary: La capitalisation boursière, c'est le cours de l'action multiplié par le nombre d'actions, pas les ventes. Walmart vend plus du double de Microsoft, mais Microsoft vaut presque quatre fois plus.

scenes.say: Walmart sells more than twice as much as Microsoft. Yet Microsoft is worth almost four times as much. How?
Because a company's value isn't its sales. Its value, called market cap, is the share price times the number of shares.

visual.title: Market cap = price × shares
visual.label: a company's value isn't its sales

scenes.say: Microsoft: about five hundred and eight dollars a share, times seven point four billion shares. That's about three point eight trillion dollars. Walmart? About one trillion.
Investors aren't buying sales. They're buying future profits. Microsoft kept about forty cents of every dollar it sold as profit. Walmart kept about three cents.
So investors pay about eleven dollars for each dollar of Microsoft's yearly sales, and about one dollar forty for Walmart's. And that value moves every time the share price does.
